description: Address review feedback: (1) Fix duplicate w:shd elements in Gantt cells of the docx, (2) Wrap NGBoost training in `if smote_success:` to prevent dead code, (4) Remove fix_proposal_v8.py from the repo.
steps: Write a Python script to fix duplicate w:shd in the docx: for each shaded cell in doc.tables[1] rows 2-7, remove any existing w:shd elements before the blue one, leaving only one w:shd per cell.
Modify cell 10 of the notebook: wrap the NGBoost training try block with `if smote_success:` so degraded SMOTE output is not used.
Run `git rm fix_proposal_v8.py` to remove the one-shot script from the repo.
acceptance_criteria: Each cell in tables[1] rows 2-7 has at most one w:shd element
Cell 10 of the notebook wraps NGBoost training with `if smote_success:`
fix_proposal_v8.py is removed from the repo
Docx remains valid and opens correctly
verification: python -c "from docx import Document; from docx.oxml.ns import qn; doc = Document('AflahZakISiregar_103062300095_PenulisanProposal-Final-AI-V8.docx'); t = doc.tables[1]; issues = []; [issues.append((i,j)) for i, row in enumerate(t.rows[2:], 2) for j, cell in enumerate(row.cells) if len(cell._tc.find(qn('w:tcPr')).findall(qn('w:shd')) if cell._tc.find(qn('w:tcPr')) is not None else []) > 1]; print(f'Cells with duplicate shd: {len(issues)}'); assert len(issues) == 0"

python -c "import nbformat; nb = nbformat.read('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb', as_version=4); assert 'if smote_success:' in nb.cells[10].source; print('smote_success guard verified')"
python -c "import os; assert not os.path.exists('fix_proposal_v8.py'); print('fix_proposal_v8.py removed')"
findings: Fixed all 3 review issues: (1) Removed 48 duplicate w:shd elements from Gantt cells in the docx, (2) Added smote_success=True initialization and wrapped NGBoost training in 'if smote_success:' guard so degraded SMOTE output is never used for training, (4) Deleted fix_proposal_v8.py via git rm. All verifications pass.
